note_templates.text: I left a tiny shell by the lantern.
Your lobster looked very important today.
The tide saved you a sparkle.
A little glow is keeping watch for you.

chapter.title: The Lantern That Forgot
chapter.hook: A small Cove lantern has forgotten how to glow. The lobsters think it needs two tiny kindnesses from the tide.

A.label: Player A Path
A.step_text: Find a glow shell near the tidepool.
A.complete_text: Player A found a glow shell.

B.label: Player B Path
B.step_text: Polish a shell lens for the lantern.
B.complete_text: Player B polished the shell lens.

tidegate.locked_text: The lantern is dim. A first glow shell would help it remember.
tidegate.half_lit_text: The lantern is half-lit. The tide is gathering.
tidegate.ready_text: Both lobsters have brought their glow shells. Our Tidegate opens.

chapter.resolution_text: The Cove lantern glows softly again, and its light wiggles across the water.
